title: Patient Routing to Skilled Nursing Facilities: The Consequences of the Medicare Reimbursement Rule
eligible_reason: Patient-level cross-sectional comparison exploiting the Medicare three-day rule. Discharge to a skilled nursing facility is regressed on daygeq3 (length of stay >= 3 days), medicare and their interaction, with hospital and DRG FE and patient controls (Table 2), plus length-of-stay profiles by payer. Not a panel with staggered adoption. HCUP SID and AHA data cannot be redistributed; the package ships only synthetic data for code validation.
design_notes: 2_Main_Analysis.do lines 176-188 (Table 2: reg/reghdfe <outcome> daygeq3 medicare daygeq3medicare, absorb(hospid drg), cluster hsanum); lines 41-47 length-of-stay dummies by payer.
data_access: proprietary (HCUP SID, AHA Annual Survey via NBER) plus OSCAR
data_files_note: README: 3_Synthetic_Analysis.do creates synthetic data that does NOT replicate the results.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
